sections.title: Research Header, Gates and Data Confidence
sections.text: Accent Microcell Limited trades on NSE SME as ACCENTMIC, ISIN INE0Q5D01013. This assessment uses standalone AS accounts, a five-year investment horizon and a 15% nominal equity hurdle before investor taxes. The research cutoff is October 5, 2026. The selected comparable growth window is FY23–26. A 500-share lot costs ₹334,950 at the dated quote, so a ₹5 lakh reference position cannot be implemented exactly. [A26](https://archives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_29644_ACCENTMIC_2025_2026_A_5826821_08072026112035.pdf) [ASME](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/emerge/corporates/content/SME_EQUITY_L.csv) [AM](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/cm/BhavCopy_NSE_CM_0_0_0_20261001_F_0000.csv.zip) Update cutoff 20 October 2026: new 14 October limited-review standalone AS half-year results supersede prior statement that no later financial period was available. H1 means six months, not July–September quarter. Current 23,989,000 shares and officialSM/500 lot observed; no main-board migration is assumed. [AH1] [AM]

sections.title: Scorecard and Calculation Audit
sections.text: GOV5, MOAT6, REV8, DUR7, CAP5, CASH6, BAL7, EXEC4, EARN6. BQS=.20×5+.20×6+.12×8+.10×7+.12×5+.10×6+.08×7+.08×4=5.94. GQS=.40×8+.20×7+.15×6+.15×5+.10×6=6.85. CASH rises one point because extended customer credit actually collected, not because a single half-year ratio can be annualized. Historical comparable revenue window remains four annual observations, so REV cannot exceed 8. RNS, D3, P3, L7; IAS unavailable without renormalizing.

sections.title: Business Overview
sections.text: Accent manufactures microcrystalline cellulose and other excipients for pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, food and other applications. Pirana and Dahej are operating plants; Unit III introduces new excipients and additional MCC capacity in phases. FY26 revenue was ₹349.03 crore and PAT ₹43.86 crore. Purchases of stock-in-trade rose to ₹95.55 crore, so growth in gross revenue is not wholly growth in proprietary manufacturing. [A26](https://archives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_29644_ACCENTMIC_2025_2026_A_5826821_08072026112035.pdf) [ADECK](https://accentmicrocell.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Presentation_compressed.pdf) New half-year disclosures show trading purchases sharply lower. This is not proof of new-plant commissioning: existing manufacturing/product mix and trading reduction must be separated from future UnitIII volumes. H1 operating EBITDA excludes other income; the deck’s 25.11% reported EBITDA margin includes it. [AH1] [AHDECK]

sections.title: Moat / Industry Position
sections.text: Qualification, grade consistency and customer documentation create switching friction. Raw-material and selling-price competition still constrain pricing power. Sigachi is a direct excipient peer, but its FY26 operations were affected by the Pashamylaram incident and it also has API and O&M businesses. Its current margin or P/E is therefore not a clean benchmark for Accent. No peer valuation premium is assumed. [A26](https://archives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_29644_ACCENTMIC_2025_2026_A_5826821_08072026112035.pdf) [APEER](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/AR_31750_SIGACHI_2025_2026_A_13436450_07092026183740.pdf)

sections.title: Revenue Growth & Scale
sections.text: Later annual reports show FY23–26 revenue of ₹197.27, ₹245.50, ₹264.58 and ₹349.03 crore, a 20.95% three-year CAGR. IPO restatements show FY21/22 revenue of ₹132.57/₹165.71 crore. However, the IPO’s FY23 revenue of ₹204.19 crore differs from the later annual comparative of ₹197.27 crore. A seamless five-year series is not asserted without that reconciliation. H2 FY26 sales rose 51.3%, but one strong half-year does not establish sustained volume-only acceleration. [AIPO](https://accentmicrocell.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/Accent-Prospectus.pdf) [A24](https://accentmicrocell.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/Accent-Annual-Report-2023-24.pdf) [A26](https://archives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_29644_ACCENTMIC_2025_2026_A_5826821_08072026112035.pdf) H1FY27 revenue 174.8309 cr versus 139.3670 cr, +25.45%; PAT31.1160 cr versus 18.0682 cr. CalculatedTTM revenue 384.4967 cr andPAT56.9064 cr. Existing disclosures label the period half-year; third-party quarter labels are rejected. [AH1]

sections.title: Growth Quality & Reinvestment Runway
sections.text: The full-capital incremental NOPAT proxy is 14.17% over FY23–26, around the assumed 12–16% cost-of-capital range. Constant-margin sensitivities are weaker. Capital includes undeployed CWIP, capital advances and capital creditors. New capacity receives no credit for projected premium products before approvals, dispatches and collections. The August order for a 4.45 MW wind turbine has no disclosed price; savings cannot be counted without funding the asset. [A24](https://accentmicrocell.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/Accent-Annual-Report-2023-24.pdf) [A26](https://archives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_29644_ACCENTMIC_2025_2026_A_5826821_08072026112035.pdf) [AWIND](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/ACCENT_13082026105256_Intimation_for_Wind_turbine.pdf) The 15 October deck still says UnitIII under commissioning, with environmental/operating/power approvals in progress; PhaseII targetH1FY28. Its plant potential and customer approvals are management claims, not completed revenue. Do not treat land for six phases as an investment return. [AHDECK] The October deck quotes phase capex₹70 crore/₹55–60 crore but also cumulative deployment₹72.48 crore/₹62.80 crore. That is not a reconciled remaining-cost schedule; subtraction cannot establish zero future commitments. The August wind purchase order does not disclose price. Hence the combined₹20–80 crore cash parameter remains a what-if range, not a verified project budget. [AHDECK] [AWIND]

sections.title: Management, Governance & Execution
sections.text: The financial and internal-control opinions are unmodified, and audit-trail reporting is affirmative. Related parties account for ₹46.20 crore of goods/services purchases and ₹23.94 crore of sales. Four promoter-directors receive ₹5.824 crore in remuneration, 13.3% of PAT. These are minority-shareholder monitoring items, not evidence of diversion. Independent director Chintan Bhatt resigned because of time constraints. Unit III delays are assessed against earlier company and rating timelines rather than only the latest target. [A26](https://archives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_29644_ACCENTMIC_2025_2026_A_5826821_08072026112035.pdf) [ARES](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/ACCENT_30062026104951_Resignation_Chintan_bhatt.pdf) [ACALL](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/ACCENT_21052026164310_Investor_Meet_Transcript.pdf) New 17 cr ICD requires counterparty, security, term and repayment confirmation; its existence is disclosed, but no related-party status or diversion is inferred without evidence. June promoter market sale is separately disclosed, not an automatic governance failure. [AH1] [APIT] Final refresh: the July AGM approved replacement independent director Pooja Shah and four remuneration ceilings of₹25 lakh per month each, up to₹12 crore annually, versus FY26 actual₹5.824 crore. The ceiling is authorization, not proof it is paid. The July board filing refers to3 July appointment while the annual notice states6 July; the date inconsistency is retained rather than silently reconciled. April promoter declaration reports13,305,840 shares at31 March and no encumbrance created duringFY26; neither establishes current holdings/pledges after the separately disclosed June sale. The AGM voting total is not substituted for promoter ownership. [AAGM] [ABOARD] [APLEDGE]

sections.title: Financial Forensics
sections.text: FY26 CFO was ₹18.64 crore against PAT of ₹43.86 crore. Receivables absorbed ₹25.27 crore, and government/vendor advances also weakened conversion. Three-year CFO/PAT is 0.510×. Cash investment in PPE and advances was ₹87.65 crore, funded with rights proceeds and older deposit redemptions. Unspent rights proceeds of ₹10.55 crore and IPO proceeds of ₹0.43 crore remain purpose-bound. Recorded capital creditors of ₹12.28 crore are additional to unprovided capital commitments of ₹15.52 crore. [A24](https://accentmicrocell.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/Accent-Annual-Report-2023-24.pdf) [A26](https://archives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_29644_ACCENTMIC_2025_2026_A_5826821_08072026112035.pdf) September update: CFO78.2808 cr includes 46.4595 cr receivable release; subtracting that release gives 31.8213 cr versusPAT31.1160 cr. Gross capital outflow 61.3109 cr leaves 16.9699 cr, but ICD17 cr absorbs it before dividend/interest. CombinedFY24–H1FY27 CFO/PAT is 0.9618×, a more balanced full-cycle reading. Cash equivalents 0.4748 cr plusotherbank 17.0842 cr are not automatically unrestricted. CWIP134.6621 cr remains nonproductive until commissioning. [AH1] Historical EPS is reported on distinct bases: FY21₹3.72/FY22₹4.57 in the bonus-adjusted IPO record; FY23₹10.06 in that record but₹9.46 in the FY24 annual comparative, with PAT₹13.0102 crore versus₹12.2321 crore respectively; FY24₹18.67, FY25₹14.91 and FY26₹18.65 in their stated later bases. Do not splice them into a fully comparable five-year EPS CAGR. Both14 October results uploads have identical file hashes, so the later upload is not treated as a financial revision. [AIPO] [A24] [A26] [AH1] [AH1DUP]

sections.title: Valuation & Market Expectations
sections.text: The prior March-based model is superseded rather than merely repriced: H1 capex and project payments cannot be charged twice. At₹654.40 and 2.3989 cr shares, equity value₹1569.8402 cr; TTM reported ownerP/E27.59×. A new five-step model starts withTTM revenue 384.4967 cr, nominal netcash 16.9383 cr after reserving debt; ICD17 cr is excluded. Base growth 8% then 12%, EBIT18%, maintenance 4% sales, economicDA3%, incremental growthcapital 0.5×added sales,25% tax,0.5% dilution,1% entry/exit costs. Remaining combined project/wind cash 20–80 cr and bank 0/20/35 cr are what-if axes, not verified commitments. At 60 cr outflow/20 cr facility the base has 5.72 cr funding gap: no investable IRR. At funded combinations its return is 2.19–2.74%. Bull 17.49% depends on stronger 22% EBIT and 20% later growth. The unfunded midpoint’s mechanical hurdle prices are not investable entries. [AH1] [AHDECK] [ACARE] [AM] Additional sensitivity uses₹40 crore remaining project cash and₹20 crore facility, not a new base forecast: incremental annual pay of₹0/₹3.088/₹6.176 crore changes funded IRR from2.50% to1.84%/1.16%. The full difference could overstate costs already included in TTM margin. Reserving all₹17.0842 crore other bank balances instead makes that illustration unfunded by₹2.81 crore, or₹7.44 crore at the full pay difference. Separately reserving₹2.4495 crore current provisions, or₹14.8366 crore including other current liabilities, tests availability without calling all balances tax due or adding overlapping capital creditors twice. These alternatives are not cumulative. Opening balances are recorded September balances; forecast working-capital ratios apply only to added sales. [AH1] [A26] [AAGM]

sections.title: Bear Case & Permanent-Loss Path
sections.text: Severe scenario: sales−25%, EBIT8% for 2 years then 12%,45 extraARdays,10% receivable/inventory losses,10 crsupplierwithdrawal and 5 crregulatorycash, with committed-projectcash 60 cr. Growthcapex stops but maintenance continues. At 20 cr assumed borrowing capacity the deficit reaches 79.05 cr; no rescue or executable bearIRR is assumed. ICD was excluded initially and is not deducted twice. Near-debt-free opening balance is important favorable evidence; this is a future capex/cash-conversion stress, not observed default. Exact contractual cancellation rights and remaining commitments could materially alter the path. [AH1] [A26]

sections.title: 5× / 10× Feasibility
sections.text: 5×/10× in five years at₹654.40 imply₹3272/₹6544 and 38.0%/58.5% annual price growth. At 25× owner earnings and 2.45948 cr projected shares, required ownerPAT is about₹321.89/₹643.78 cr before treasury adjustments, againstTTM56.91 cr. Capacity potential alone is insufficient: approvals, actual orders, margins, workingcapital and reinvestment funding must all connect. The bull is not a 5×case.

sections.title: Monitoring Plan
sections.text: Monitor environmental clearance and power approval, actual commercial dispatches, phase-wise utilization and incremental profit. Obtain the wind price, payment schedule and evidence of savings. Check receivable ageing, related-party trading, capital creditors, remaining commitments and restricted proceeds. Verify the usable fund-based portion of bank limits, EPCG obligations, and current lot, spread, depth and circuit conditions before implementation. Add: reconcile 17 crICD terms/receipts; distinguish cashcollection from margin uplift; verify remaining obligations afterH1 spend. Promoterholding in investor presentation is explicitly 31 March, not currentSeptember. Current SM/500 lot/official 60 day data retained; do not infer surveillance codes 100/0 without legend. L7: starting9 for0.321 theoretical sessions at5% participation, minus1 for500-share lot₹327,200 and minus1 combined judgment for concentrated participant breadth, SME trading caution, volatility and unobserved live depth. EOD19 October REG1, effective21 October, flags fewer than100 unique PANs in30 days, SME not regularly traded, high–low variation above150% in12 months and close-to-close movement above100% in365 days. All60 sampled sessions actually traded; the exchange caution is not evidence of zero-volume days. No match in named ASM/ESM/GSM lists is not blanket clearance. Current SM and20% band are observed, not a guarantee of sale. [AREG] [ALEGEND] [AESM] [AASM] [AGSM]

sections.title: Final Classification & Conditional Action
sections.text: Established excipient business with improved cash realization, still a commissioning/funding watch rather than an evidenced high-quality-compounder entry. BQS5.94/GQS6.85; IASNS. Near-zero debt does not guarantee every future expansion is funded. Retain quality rankings withMedium evidence confidence but no investment-attractiveness ranking until remaining capex and bank/deposit availability are bounded by documents.

sections.title: Sources, Assumptions & Open Questions
sections.text: Annual reports, IPO restatements, current exchange filings, the rating report and the company call were reviewed. The NSE SME master verifies current listing; official daily bhavcopies provide the dated lot and turnover series. Missing wind cost and bank interchangeability terms are material. The older restatement and rights-adjusted EPS bridges remain incomplete, so the corresponding five-year headline fields are ND. No commissioning confirmation was found in the checked April–October 5 SME announcements. Sigachi’s annual was obtained independently from NSE after its issuer download returned 403; that issuer route was not retried. New 14 October reviewed results and 15 October management deck are differentiated from audited annuals. Prior archive untouched. Prior 6.89% illustration is obsolete for this cutoff. Annual 5 yearEPS and fully comparable 5 year revenue remainND because IPO/annual restatement and rights bridges are not fully reconciled. Current price/turnover comes from exchange, not undatedCSV. NewICD terms and wind price remain specific open questions. Pertinent post-annual filings through20 October were checked, including resignation/replacement, AGM pay ceilings, wind order and duplicate H1 results. No later interim ownership category is inferred from vote totals. Remaining funding, deposit availability and ICD terms still block R/IAS, despite completed conditional research and sensitivity work.
